pool.streik_gespraech.e.e1: Coach, I need to talk to you. The way things stand, I can't just carry on as if nothing had happened.
pool.streik_gespraech.e.e2: I'm staying away from training until we have a solution. This isn't a whim, it's a decision.
pool.streik_gespraech.e.e3: You wouldn't let me leave, and now you expect me to stay put. That's not how this works.
pool.streik_gespraech.a.a1: You have my word: in the next window we talk about your move, and I won't stand in your way.
pool.streik_gespraech.a.a2: I understand what's driving you. Tell me what you need and we'll find a way together.
pool.streik_gespraech.a.a3: The club's situation doesn't allow a departure right now. I'm happy to explain why.
pool.streik_gespraech.a.a4: Give me a little more time, then we'll see.
pool.streik_gespraech.a.a5: You have a contract and it stands. I expect you at training tomorrow.
pool.streik_gespraech.a.a6: There are no strikes under me. Anyone who behaves like that has no demands to make in this squad.
pool.streik_gespraech.r.r1: {b.gut} That is exactly what I wanted to hear from you.
pool.streik_gespraech.r.r2: {b.neutral} That will take a while to sink in.
pool.streik_gespraech.r.r3: {b.schlecht} Then we have nothing more to say to each other.

pool.streik_gespraech.x.x2: {name} is waiting it out, the matter is far from settled.

pool.streik_einsatz.e.e1: I won't play this weekend. I'm telling you in person so you don't read it in the paper.
pool.streik_einsatz.e.e2: After everything that has happened between us, I won't pull on the shirt for you any more.
pool.streik_einsatz.e.e3: It isn't easy for me, but in this situation I can't go out onto the pitch.
pool.streik_einsatz.a.a1: I'm granting you your release: as soon as a suitable club turns up, I'll let you go. Until then you play for us.
pool.streik_einsatz.a.a2: I'll come up with something to make up for it, and we'll talk everything through calmly.
pool.streik_einsatz.a.a3: The board expects professionalism from both of us. Let's work out what is possible.
pool.streik_einsatz.a.a4: Please take that up with the sporting director. I'll pass it on to him.
pool.streik_einsatz.a.a5: Then you'll sit in the stands, and the fans will know why.
pool.streik_einsatz.a.a6: You leave not a day before I decide. That is my final word.
pool.streik_einsatz.r.r1: {b.gut} That is something to work with, and I appreciate it.
pool.streik_einsatz.r.r2: {b.neutral} I'll let you know once I've made up my mind.
pool.streik_einsatz.r.r3: {b.schlecht} If that's all, I'm leaving now.

pool.vertrag_verweigert_star.e.e1: My client won't extend on the old terms. There are offers on the table and the clock is ticking.
pool.vertrag_verweigert_star.e.e2: Time is running short: soon my client may talk to other clubs, and then there will be no fee for you.
pool.vertrag_verweigert_star.e.e3: My client wants more than money, he wants a future and recognition. So far I sense little of either.
pool.vertrag_verweigert_star.a.a1: We'll meet the demand. Let's sit down and put it on paper today.
pool.vertrag_verweigert_star.a.a2: What exactly is the line above which your client signs?
pool.vertrag_verweigert_star.a.a3: We are a club with a plan, and your client is part of it. Let's talk about that.
pool.vertrag_verweigert_star.a.a4: Give us a little more time and we'll come back with a proper proposal.
pool.vertrag_verweigert_star.a.a5: That demand is excessive. We're sticking to our offer, and the player knows it.
pool.vertrag_verweigert_star.a.a6: There will be no extension on those terms. That is our answer.
pool.vertrag_verweigert_star.r.r1: {b.gut} That sounds like a path we can walk together.
pool.vertrag_verweigert_star.r.r2: {b.neutral} I'll put that to my client and get back to you.
pool.vertrag_verweigert_star.r.r3: {b.schlecht} Then we will probably meet soon on the other side of the table.
